sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0344: part BR-310; plant TO2; customer CLM; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-5083-H111; status APPROVED 2025-06-11 (PPAP-2025-052)
Scope: series production parts released at Torino Plant 1 (TO1) and Torino Plant 2 (TO2) for customers Stellantis (STL) and Cantieri Lombardi Mobility S.p.A. (CLM).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).
Proposed change, as said in the meeting: Run BR-310 for Cantieri Lombardi at Plant 1 using Meccanica C billet, the Plant 2 line is down.

findings.why: Meccanica C's only approval for BR-310 is for plant TO2 and customer CLM. The ASL is in scope for TO1 and CLM and lists no BR-310 approval at TO1. The proposed run at Plant 1 therefore has no current source release.
